The review is organized around dataset construction, model development, training and fine-tuning, benchmark evaluation, physics enhancement, and applications in materials discovery. 2. Foundation of uMLFFs: Data, Strategies and Benchmarks The performance of uMLFFs depends on three coupled factors: model architecture (determining representational upper bound), training data coverage (defining applicability limits), and benchmark testing (assessing real-task reliability). figures.caption: Figure 8. Violin plots of phonon-property errors relative to the PBE reference data. The compared quantities include (a) maximum phonon frequency, (b) vibrational entropy, (c) Helmholtz free energy, (d) heat capacity, (e) phonon density of states and (f) average sound velocity. Adapted from Ref. 63: Loew et al., npj Computational Materials 2025, 11, 178. Phonon frequencies depend on the force-constant matrix, i.e., the second derivative of the PES with respect to atomic displacement. Two distinct error mechanisms should be separated.
